owner: DelegatedCheckoutApi over the existing durable intent owner
authentication: Existing opaque customer bearer and current native customer/resource/contact proof, before input collection and native lookup; exact loopback host/origin checks. No remote delegate qualification.
input_policy: Strict UTF-8 JSON with no duplicate members or malformed Unicode; exact original preview/context references only. Tenant and store come from the authenticated native session. No intent creation, snapshots, URLs, credentials, authority flags or trust/context provisioning.
lookup: Derive the existing tenant/store-bound identity and compare its complete digest on the selected validated record. Reuse current customer proof and the ordinary expiry/view/final-access fences. Live preview, context and receipt owners are unnecessary and are never reconstructed.
absence: NOT_FOUND is an observation under the current session and original references. It does not prove that another operation is safe, authorize replacement preparation or permit automatic mutation retry.
retention: Cancelled, minimized, held and restored records retain the existing read projection. Supplied references may be echoed transiently for response binding; erased personal fields and live provenance are never reconstructed.
effects: No new intent, receipt, session, provider call, challenge consumption, queue, order or payment effect. Ordinary expiry observation may update the original intent revision exactly as status does.
privacy: No-store responses; finite status/code logs omit request bodies, credentials and references. Original references and bearer are not persisted by this route or client. Memory zeroization is not claimed.
compatibility: The original /v1/delegated-checkout contract and its seven routes remain unchanged. Recovery is explicit and separately contracted.
